candidates.description: This feature vector activates on Hebrew-sounding phonetic suffixes and Hebrew-derived proper name components.
This vector is related to figures, locations, and concepts from Abrahamic religions, particularly Judaism and Islam.
Common Italian grammatical words, prepositions, articles, and pronouns.
This feature vector activates on closing quotation marks or parentheses immediately followed by punctuation marks.
This feature vector represents subword tokens and fragments predominantly featuring the letter 'b' and the 'ab' phonetic sound.
This vector represents single uppercase and lowercase consonant letters of the alphabet.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing or related to the Latin root "div"/"dif" meaning apart or separate, as well as various sub-word fragments starting with "di-" or "ar-".
This feature vector activates strongly on the letter sequence "iv" (or "iv"-related subwords and suffixes) across various linguistic contexts.
This vector represents common Italian adverbial and prepositional nouns used in fixed locutions and phrases.
This vector represents ordinal positioning and sequence-related terminology across multiple languages.
